tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Evaluate a safe numeric expression with arithmetic operators.

tools.name: get_current_datetime
tools.description: Get live current date, clock time, day, and timezone for the system timezone or an IANA timezone.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone such as Asia/Kolkata or America/New_York.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather and a short forecast for a location.

tools.name: get_system_info
tools.description: Get grounded operating system and machine facts for the current workspace process.

include_env_keys.description: Whether to include environment variable names. Values are never returned.

tools.name: get_pc_status
tools.description: Get grounded PC status with OS, architecture, CPU cores, memory, disk, and current workspace.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and folders in a local directory with names, types, sizes, and modified timestamps. Natural folder names are resolved through config/path_aliases.json before failing.

path.description: Directory path or configured alias such as desktop, downloads, documents, screenshots, or workspace. Defaults to the current workspace.

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read a local text file with a bounded character limit. Natural folder names are resolved through config/path_aliases.json before failing.

path.description: Text file path, including paths under configured aliases.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get local file or directory metadata such as type, size, and modified timestamp. Natural folder names are resolved through config/path_aliases.json before failing.

path.description: File or directory path, including configured aliases.

tools.name: search_text_files
tools.description: Search local text files using exact text matching, not regular expressions. Natural folder names are resolved through config/path_aliases.json before failing.

path.description: File or directory path or configured alias. Defaults to the current workspace.

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Count characters, non-space characters, words, and lines in supplied text.

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description: Compute a digest for supplied text using a hashlib algorithm such as sha256.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm name supported by Python hashlib.

tools.name: fetch_url_text
tools.description: Fetch text from a URL with bounded output, status, and content type.

tools.name: run_terminal
tools.description: Run a local terminal command for command output, installed software versions, PATH checks, tests, scripts, filesystem inspection, opening apps, opening files, opening URLs, and other grounded local actions.

command.description: Command line to run exactly as a terminal command.

cwd.description: Optional working directory. Defaults to the current workspace.

max_output_chars.description: Optional maximum characters retained separately for stdout and stderr.

shell.description: Optional shell runner. Defaults to the configured terminal shell.

background.description: Run without waiting for completion. Use this for launch/open/start requests such as opening desktop applications.

tools.name: get_runtime_info
tools.description: Get facts about the currently running Jarvis Python process, including Python version, executable, platform, argv, cwd, and environment keys. This is only for Jarvis runtime facts; do not use it for installed terminal, PATH, Node, npm, package, or system command versions.

include_env_keys.description: Whether to include environment variable names. Values are never returned.

tools.name: list_registered_tools
tools.description: List the local tools currently registered with Jarvis.
